svg.title: Learning curves for GDA and logistic regression
svg.desc: Mean test error over 400 training sets of each size, on a logarithmic axis from 6 to 400 examples. Left, data that satisfy GDA's assumptions: GDA's error is slightly lower than logistic regression's from 10 to about 100 examples, though not at 6, and the two converge on the Bayes error. Right, data whose classes are Poisson: logistic regression is correctly specified and GDA is not; GDA is still competitive at the smallest sizes, but logistic regression ends lower.
